card.name: Digit 1 inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 1 when it sits as the second digit inside a longer number, such as 21, 2.1x, or 1:10. It appears in doses, statistics, section numbers, phone numbers, times and verse references.

modes.label: Numbers in results and doses
modes.description: The digit 1 inside a decimal, range, or dose number.

modes.label: Section numbers and references
modes.description: The digit 1 ending a heading number or inside a citation or verse number.

modes.label: Phone numbers and times
modes.description: The digit 1 as the middle digit of a phone area code or a clock time.

card.plain: It marks the digit 1 in the middle of a number, for example in a dose, a statistic or a section number.
